ns2:course.label: Theories of Psychotherapy
ns2:course.description: Study of counseling and psychotherapeutic processes and theories in relation to social and cultural developments. Coverage of major models and theories as well as current and historical trends and a review of counseling skills will be included. Same as PSYC 420. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: PSYC 238 or equivalent.
